description:
Activate Arcbound Crusher by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Crusher leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Crusher
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Crusher when it left the battlefield.
When the Mutagens enter, Arcbound Crsuher triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each trigger.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Crusher and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
